metadata.provenance_note: Explicitly synthetic scenarios modeled after historical Kerala monsoon dynamics for evaluation.

scenarios.name: Standard Active Southwest Monsoon
scenarios.expected_impact: Localized minor waterlogging in poorly drained urban dips; primary roads normal.

scenarios.name: Heavy Monsoon Depression (Orange Alert)
scenarios.expected_impact: Puzhakkal lowlands inundated, Kole wetland canal bank overflow, tertiary roads affected.

scenarios.name: Centenary Extreme Rainfall Event (2018 Analog / Red Alert)
scenarios.expected_impact: Severe district-wide inundation; low-elevation corridors impassable; emergency routing mandatory.

scenarios.name: Short-Duration High-Intensity Urban Cloudburst
scenarios.expected_impact: Rapid flash waterlogging in Thrissur Swaraj Round and commercial core; high slope runoff.
